messages:
chad-customer: Hey @sophie-support / @ajay-oncall — after our network team tightened egress rules our Private deployment started failing to reach the hosted API. App logs show DNS lookup failures and some SSL errors. Example from our service: `dial tcp: lookup api-inference.redwood.com: no such host`

sophie-support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you confirm which Private cluster (region) and whether you're using a forward proxy or direct egress? Also can you paste the output of `dig api-inference.redwood.com +short` and `curl -v https://api-inference.redwood.com/health --proxy http://<proxy>` if you have a proxy?

chad-customer: We're on private-cluster-eu1, using a corporate forward proxy (explicit). Quick dig results from one of the nodes:```
$ dig api-inference.redwood.com +short
;; connection timed out; trying next server

;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL, id: 12345
```
And curl (via proxy) yields:```
* Rebuilt URL to: https://api-inference.redwood.com/health
*   Trying 10.10.0.2:8080...
* Connected to proxy.company.local (10.10.0.2) port 8080 (#0)
* Establish HTTP proxy tunnel to api-inference.redwood.com:443
* CONNECT api-inference.redwood.com:443 HTTP/1.1
* Proxy replied: 200 Connection established
* TLS handshake with remote server failed: SSL: certificate problem: unable to get local issuer certificate
* Closing connection 0
curl: (35) TLS handshake failed
